content: Roguelike upgrade-catalogue balance traps (community design consensus): multiplicative stacks of multipliers explode superlinearly (Balatro-style intentional, accidental when unintended - the current effects model is pure multiplicative over 4 knobs, so two +50% rope-speed cards compound); offer pools need per-card level caps/stack limits or late offers become dead picks; balance must be checked at N stacks not N=1 (simulate 20-card runs, not single picks); each card must change decisions, not just numbers.
